_comment: Safari-specific manifest overrides. build.sh merges these over the repo-root
manifest.json, replacing whole top-level keys (a null value deletes a key).
Keys starting with _ are stripped from the generated manifest.
background: Safari 15.4+ accepts MV3 with a non-persistent background page,
and iOS requires one. It is also the safer target on Safari because
host_permissions are not applied to background service workers there, and
long setTimeout chains - which the refresh flow depends on - survive better
in an event page than in a service worker.
